dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Discrete 'O' and 'C' shaped topologies with irregular, high-contrast dark boundaries enclosing high-intensity pixel cores. Edges exhibit non-uniform, jagged geometry with sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior borders to bright interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels concentrated in the central lateral region, appearing as saturated patches; lower density of isolated, high-intensity point-features visible in the posterior/tail region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent rings on the far right form an obtuse triangular configuration; centroids of the mid-body clusters form an irregular polygonal network spanning the central-dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct pixel-intensity gradient transition from the highly textured, high-contrast mid-body to the low-contrast, predominantly dark posterior/flipper region.
